question: Which of the following is the largest peninsular river in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Godavari River** is the** largest peninsular river in India**.
 
• The Godavari River rises from Trimbakeshwar in the Nashik district of **Maharashtra** and flows through several states, including** Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and Odisha.**
 
• With a length of approximately** 1,465 kilometres (910 miles), **the **Godavari **is often referred to as the **Dakshina Ganga or the Ganges of the South.**
 
• **The river **is known for its significance in** Hindu mythology** and its **extensive irrigation networks**, making it a lifeline for agricultural activities in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Krishna: **The Krishna River is the** second-largest peninsular river in India,** originating from the **Western Ghats of Maharashtra and flowing through Maharashtra, Karnataka,Telangana**** and Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• **Kaveri:** The Kaveri river, also known as the **Cauvery, originates from the Brahmagiri hills **in** Karnataka and flows through Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.**
 
• **Mahanadi: **The **Mahanadi River** originates from the **Chhattisgarh region and flows through Odisha before emptying into the Bay of Bengal.**
